card.name: Working paper numbers after series name
card.fires_on: The space or the first digits of a working-paper number right after a series title like "The Centre for Market and Public Organisation" in an economics citation list.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The space following the series name, just before the paper number such as 05/130.
modes.example: The Centre for Market and Public Organisation<< >>05/130, Department

modes.label: Digits of the number
modes.description: The leading zero or digit inside the paper number of the series.
modes.example: The Centre for Market and Public Organisation 0<<5>>/130, Department of Economics

card.writes: It seems to promote period-like and numbering-style tokens while suppressing "external" words.
card.plain: It fires on the paper number that follows a research series name in a reference list.
